en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a crowded town square during a fair. In the foreground stands an ornate baroque fountain with multiple statues and basins, surrounded by people in early 20th‑century dress. Market stalls and dense crowds fill the streets extending from the square. Multi‑story historic buildings with arcades and shuttered windows frame the plaza; a tall bell tower rises on the left and a domed church on the right. The printed caption at the top reads in Italian, identifying the scene as Piazza Duomo during the St. Joseph fair in Trento.
